record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) Every period of __________ from employment and every other interruption of service must be noted, with full details of its duration, in an entry made across the page of the Service Book. (b) A record of the services of a Gazetted Government servant will be kept by such Audit Officer and in such form as the __________ may prescribe. (c) No Government servant shall be granted leave of any kind for a continuous period exceeding __________ . (d) The period of absence not covered by grant of leave shall have to be treated as __________. (e) __________ means a monthly grant made to a Government servant who is not in receipt of pay or leave salary.
